title: Excavations at Khirbet el Mefjer. III
author: D. C. Baramki
location_note: Kh. el Mefjer (Hisham's palace) north of Jericho; no map reference printed; placed by name.
notes: Third season (Dec. 1936 - Mar. 1937): Court, South Block with mosque, East Block rooms, SE round tower. An ink inscription naming Hisham dates the Palace construction to AD 724-43 (excavator). A skeleton under a fallen arch (accident, after the 12th c.) is not a burial; not coded.

features.subtype: pottery drain pipe under the east wall (excavator: for waste water, probably after ablution)
features.quote: A pottery pipe was laid below the east wall to drain
